description: Critical Mineral Demand and Secondary Supply Potential for China's Solar Photovoltaic and Wind Power: A Dynamic Material Flow Analysis is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Jianchao Ge. China’s rapid deployment of solar photovoltaic (PV) and wind power creates growing critical mineral demand and substantial future material outflows. This study develops a dynamic material flow analysis framework covering five PV and four wind power subtechnologies under four scenario dimensions. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 124223 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
